title: His Light Never Goes Out
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A song says God is my bright light,
So whom then shall I fear?
A little light can chase the dark
And make the way seem clear.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father is my light,
I do not need to fear,
His love shines warm and bright in me
And holds me safe and near.

[Verse 2]
When I feel worried, small, or scared,
He shines so warm and bright,
His love goes on and never stops,
And chases off the night.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the room is dark,
But you don't need to fear,
God's light is glowing in your heart,
And He is always near.

[Chorus]
mood: Glowing music. A slow, even sway rocks under the voice like a small lamp's steady flame, warm and unhurried, matching a story about a light that pushes the dark back. The pulse stays soft and sure through the chorus so a child feels held rather than stirred. By the last verse it eases lower and slower, thinning to a hush as the eyes close.
